set-K-01.png.why: The amber headlight and wet-deck color contrast hold attention; the grounded stairwell and puddles sell the shot, though the orange billboard competes with the car.

set-K-02.png.why: The blue headlight beam gives the frame a cinematic hook, but at phone size the dark car loses definition and the skyline looks a little too evenly lit.

set-K-03.png.why: The wide-set headlights and big low-angle silhouette read immediately, though the saturated billboard and dense signage make the location feel art-directed.

set-K-04.png.why: Both headlights and the nose still read in the thumbnail, with the magenta backdrop adding impact at the cost of some naturalism.

set-K-05.png.why: The beam through mist and the low camera give it a polished reveal, but the black body recedes and the repeated skyline signage feels staged.

set-K-06.png.why: The warm Y-shaped headlight survives the reduction, and the practical doorway and wet parking lines feel believable, but the billboard pulls the eye upward.
